artistic_medium.meaning: translucent layered watercolor and glass, painterly grain, intricate spatial depth

subject.value: Week 2 Lesson 2A infographic surface: the same interval number (a third) in two different sizes, shown as a left panel and a right panel of one single painting

visual_structure.value: One unified 4:3 painting on a warm ivory watercolor-paper ground, no outer frame or card. Top 14%: a calm pale-ivory title clearing with delicate ornament above it. Below it two large luminous translucent glass-and-watercolor fields side by side, LEFT field a little wider and tinted antique amber (#AB812D), RIGHT field narrower and tinted orchid violet (#8964A4), joined by a gentle ivory bridge in the middle so they read as one family. Inside each field, leave a large calm wide pale-ivory clearing across its middle (about 30% of total height) for a keyboard diagram, and a second calm pale clearing across the lower part of each field (about 25% of height) for short explanatory text. Rich purposeful filigree, concentric ripples, fine glass layering and glowing edges live in the margins, corners and around the clearings, flowing into the content areas rather than boxing them. Across the very bottom, one calm wide pale clearing for a single summary sentence. Both fields share the same ornament grammar; left and right halves should each work as a self-contained portrait panel if cropped at the vertical centre.

accent_identity.value: left field antique amber #AB812D, right field orchid violet #8964A4, as soft washes and glows; these identify the two interval relationships only

negative_space.value: the clearings must be quiet, light, low-contrast ivory with only faint texture, so dark plum text and piano-key drawings overlaid later stay perfectly legible

background.value: full-bleed warm ivory (#F9F5ED) watercolor paper with soft organic painted edges fading into the ivory; no hard rectangle, no border line

forbidden_changes: changing the reference's warm organic art-material treatment to flat schematic vector
generic decorative swirls without a left/right pair relationship
hard rectangular boxes, poster frames, cards, borders, watermarks, UI controls
any text, letters, numerals, piano keys, notation, staff lines, arrows, labels or musical claims
ornament, texture or dark colour inside the reserved clearings
treating interval colour as a property of sound or of a voice

output.intended_use: painted surface of a finished infographic; native exact text, keys and arcs are overlaid on the clearings
